title: LIVE CHLOROPHYLL / ALGAL ACTIVITY
noaa_source: NOAA CoastWatch S-NPP+NOAA-20 VIIRS chlorophyll-a NRT gapfilled Daily (ERDDAP nesdisVHNnoaaSNPPnoaa20NRTchlaGapfilledDaily), fallback SQ Daily (nesdisVHNSQchlaDaily)
product_name: NOAA CoastWatch S-NPP+NOAA-20 VIIRS chlorophyll-a NRT gapfilled Daily (ERDDAP nesdisVHNnoaaSNPPnoaa20NRTchlaGapfilledDaily), fallback SQ Daily (nesdisVHNSQchlaDaily)
spatial_resolution_source: ~9 km VIIRS NRT (0.0833 deg), 7-day median mosaic, NaN-aware display smoothing
spatial_resolution_rendered: 1800x1175 canvas over lon [-93.0,-73.5], lat [40.5,49.5] (mean-value binning, no upsampling of source precision)
missing_data_treatment: cloud/land/fill (NaN) transparent; only [0.001,1000.0] values admitted; never interpolated; colors follow Carlson TSI(chl-a), values shown as TSI.
shoreline_mask: assets/great_lakes_watermask.png — shared NOAA medium-resolution shoreline water mask (nautical-chart compilation, mean-high-water datum; snapped + polygonized once, full vertex precision, antialiased). Overlay alpha is multiplied by this mask and edge RGB is bled into transparent pixels (anti-fringe for bilinear clients), so every product shares one shoreline.

legend_scale_html: Carlson Trophic State Index from chlorophyll-a (fixed 0-100 scale, even 5-unit steps): 0-35 Oligotrophic (deep blue→green, chl 0.04-1.62) → 40-45 Mesotrophic (yellow-green, chl 2.6-4.1) → 50-60 Eutrophic (gold→red-orange, chl 6.4-20) → 65-100 Hypereutrophic (red→violet→dark, chl 31-1183). Legend labels show TSI (chl-a ug/L). Same TSI always shows the same color. High TSI = biomass / activity, not toxins.
folder_html:
Legend

Carlson Trophic State Index from chlorophyll-a (fixed 0-100 scale, even 5-unit steps): 0-35 Oligotrophic (deep blue→green, chl 0.04-1.62) → 40-45 Mesotrophic (yellow-green, chl 2.6-4.1) → 50-60 Eutrophic (gold→red-orange, chl 6.4-20) → 65-100 Hypereutrophic (red→violet→dark, chl 31-1183). Legend labels show TSI (chl-a ug/L). Same TSI always shows the same color. High TSI = biomass / activity, not toxins.

Chlorophyll-a concentration at the lake surface, a proxy for phytoplankton abundance/biomass, shown on the Carlson Trophic State Index 0-100. NOT a toxin measurement and NOT a harmful-algal-bloom diagnosis.

Units: TSI (Carlson TSI from chlorophyll-a)
Source: NOAA CoastWatch S-NPP+NOAA-20 VIIRS chlorophyll-a NRT gapfilled Daily (ERDDAP nesdisVHNnoaaSNPPnoaa20NRTchlaGapfilledDaily), fallback SQ Daily (nesdisVHNSQchlaDaily)
Update: daily composites
Why high values turn red/purple: Carlson TSI trophic scale: oligotrophic blues through mesotrophic yellows and eutrophic oranges, with only hypereutrophic water reaching red-violet/deep-purple.
Provenance: ERDDAP dataset
